test_shared_kernel_module_docstrings_do_not_call_code_review_future only targets review_kernel/__init__.py, discovery.py, prompting/prompts.py — not docs/llm-framework.md, so the stale wording is unguarded.
advisory.finding: The change corrects 'future code-review' in the three source modules but leaves the same stale 'future code-review op' wording in docs/llm-framework.md:408, which directly mirrors the prompts.py comment that was corrected — the doc is now inconsistent with the corrected source, and the new pinning test does not guard this file so the drift can silently persist.
scenarios: A reader consults docs/llm-framework.md and sees the shipped code-review op described as 'future', contradicting the corrected source comments.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a positive presence assertion (the corrected 'code-review gate' wording appears in each target) alongside the `assert not 'future code-review'` in test_shared_kernel_module_docstrings_do_not_call_code_review_future.
evidence: The only assertion is a negated regex search over a file read with no presence anchor; the corrected wording (e.g. discovery.py:8 'Both review gates (plan-review and code-review) consume this ONE kernel') is never asserted to exist.
Fail-open rationale: the check yields its passing result in the world where the code-review-gate sentence is removed entirely, indistinguishable from the world where it is correctly present.
advisory.finding: test_shared_kernel_module_docstrings_do_not_call_code_review_future is an absence-only oracle: it asserts the stale phrase 'future code-review' is NOT present but never asserts the corrected 'code-review gate' wording IS present. It passes trivially both when the docstring correctly describes the shipped gate and when the code-review-gate mention is deleted or reorganized away entirely, so it cannot detect a regression that drops the description rather than reverting its wording.
scenarios: A future refactor deletes or rewrites the affected docstring paragraph so it no longer mentions the code-review gate at all — the test still passes green.
advisory.suggested_fix: For each target file, additionally assert the corrected phrase is present, e.g. `assert re.search(r"code-review (?:op|gate)", text)`, so the test fails if the description is removed rather than merely reworded.
